<details open>

mtmd: speed up shared audio FFT (#32815)

* mtmd: speed up shared audio FFT

Replace recursive radix-2 splitting with iterative stages and
batch the existing odd-size DFT across subsequences, preserving
the previous operation order.

Input buffers now hold only N real values for FFT
or 2N interleaved floats for inverse FFT.

Add test_audio_fft for forward and inverse transforms.

Assisted-by: Claude

* nits

---------

Co-authored-by: Xuan Son Nguyen <son@huggingface.co>

</details>
